text:
Amy Chen: Quick sync 1  we still need per-SKU reserved vs ephemeral inputs from VoltCloud and Zenith for the cost model refresh. VoltCloud said they'd send a CSV but I haven't seen the full schema yet.
Jordan Patel: Right. Minimum useful fields: sku, region, sku_tier, commit_tenor_days, min_commit_gpu, reserved_ratio, avg_spot_usd, spot_floor_usd, spot_ceiling_usd, preempt_prob_90d, eviction_lead_time_mins, burst_capacity_pct, fill_rate_90d. Also be explicit about billing granularity (per-minute vs per-hour).
Sanjay Rao: For modeling QoS premiums, we also need avg_latency_p95_ms (or a range). If they can't give exact numbers, a tier envelope works.
Kevin Liu: @Rina can you confirm whether VoltCloud provides prorated hour billing on evictions? That changes effective unit cost when instances are preempted mid-hour.
Rina (voltcloud-vendor): VoltCloud here. We do prorate to the minute for preemptions. We'll share CSV by EOD tomorrow. Notes column will include maintenance blackout windows.
Elena (marketplace-bot): Zenith uploaded zenith_spot_curves_may.csv to vendor dropbox: https://files.redwood/zenith/may (automated)
Amy Chen: Awesome, thanks. Once Kevin pulls both files, please call out missing columns. Finance needs consolidated by Fri for Q3 planning.
Jordan Patel: Also request: a small sample of historical fill-rate time series (weekly for last 12 weeks) if partners are willing. It helps simulate burst behavior.
Kevin Liu: I'll import and run a quick validation. If any quirks show up (csv encodings, header differences) I'll paste a diff here.
Sanjay Rao: If partners are tight on data sharing, ask for aggregated percentiles (p10/p50/p90) for spot price and fill_rate over 90d. That keeps vendor comfortable while still useful.
Amy Chen: Plan B: if no vendor data, we'll default to marketplace scraper + conservative fudge factors (reserve_utilization 0.6, eviction_delta +30%). Not ideal but keeps the modeling runnable.
Kevin Liu: Copy that. I'll post validation results in this thread.
Amy Chen: Thanks everyone.
